description: Erection of a ground and first floor side extension, rear roof extension with a front roof window and erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statement;  EX00; Received - 09 August 2019
Flood Risk Assessment; Received - 13 August 2019
EX01; EX02; EX03; EX04; EX05; EX06; EX07; EX08; EX09; EX10; EX11; Received -  24 September 2019
Amended Plans: P01; P02; P03; P04; P05; P06; P07; P08; P09; P10; P11;  Received -  25 September 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
Condition : 5 - The development shall conform to the Flood Risk Assessment submitted and approved with this application.
